# tritonctl team

Who is in your tenant, and invitations

Subcommands: list, invite, invitations, revoke, roles, remove

Usage: `tritonctl team [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl team list

List the members of your tenant

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl team list [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl team invite

Invite someone by email

Usage: `tritonctl team invite [OPTIONS] --role <ROLES> <EMAIL>`

- `<EMAIL>`
- `--role <ROLES>`: A role for the invitee. Repeatable (required; one of: admin, member, viewer, billing-viewer, billing-manager)

## tritonctl team invitations

List the open invitations

Usage: `tritonctl team invitations [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl team revoke

Withdraw an invitation

Usage: `tritonctl team revoke [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: The invitee's email, or the invitation uuid or prefix
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails

## tritonctl team roles

Set a member's roles, replacing the current set

Usage: `tritonctl team roles [OPTIONS] --role <ROLES> <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Member username, email, uuid, or prefix
- `--role <ROLES>`: A role. Repeatable (required; one of: admin, member, viewer, billing-viewer, billing-manager)

## tritonctl team remove

Remove a member from your tenant

Usage: `tritonctl team remove [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Member username, email, uuid, or prefix
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails
